notes.title: Demo hotfix - Build 127
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug where having a merge active in certain positions could brick the game.


Thanks to Discord user Monknot for reproducing the issue !

notes.title: Big Update - Updated Demo Out Now !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041880/5f8c6fe5221d2787bd20df91777a4a859946552a.png

This new and updated version includes new systems such as Item Merging and a complete Talent Tree to unlock and discover. Also many Quality of Life and visual improvements had been added.

Discover more than 40 weapons and over 180 items, equipment and relics.

Check out the demo and let us know what you think of it !


We are very excited to have made the next step towards an Early Access Release and would love to hear your thoughts.

You can join our Discord to follow development, check out the Roadmap and share your awesome builds with others.


Happy Gaming !


Chris & Martijn
CM Game Studio

notes.title: Demo Update - Build 75
notes.notes:
Features:
- Added Rotate tips to Q&E for keyboard
- Showing Backpack preview on pause menu opened by default


Fixes:

- Fixed vendor counter being visible in end boss arena
- Fixed bag tutorial starting after returning to Fortress
- Fixed some sounds not respecting Master Volume setting
- Fixed Adventure Completed UI not disappearing upon returning to Fortress
- Fixed enemy spawn rate during boss fight
- Fixed vendor spawning in inaccesible locations
- Fixed steam name font size for long names
- Fixed [Skip tutorial] hints possibly overlaying on top of eachother



Balancing:
- Lowered prices
- Lowered enemy health & count
- Lowered enemy spawn rate during (mini)Boss fights
- Increased chance at epic and legendary shop offers
- Reduced titanic soul unlocks in price
- Ring of Greed conditional stats changed from +5 pierce to +5% damage
- Global rebalancing on multiple items

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - Build 74 released
notes.notes:
Features:
- Set base audio levels to 50%
- Highlight shop sell area when dragging items
- Added sellprice to tooltips
- Show item size in tooltip


Fixes:
- Fixed save slot UI not scaling correctly
- Fixed level audio still playing after finishing an adventure
- Fixed lighting on pyroclasmic staff 
- Fixed Adventure UI mocing Hellfire slider when switching between adventures widh A/D
- Fixed gray border disappearing when locking an item in the shop
- Fixed audio issue with Beetle barrage attack
- Fixed tooltip targeting on Stone Greatsword
- Fixed Continue shop button not always interactable
- Fixed a possible crash when deleting a save and trying to continue
- Fixed WASD tooltip showing when playing with controller

Balancing:
- Increased price of Whip
